{{Quote|While the cataclysmic storm on Kamino was tragic, the reality is that without the production of new clone troopers, we are vulnerable. Admiral Rampart's proposed Defense Recruitment Bill will keep us protected.|Gani Riduli|<ref name="The Clone Conspiracy" />}}
'''Gani Riduli''' was an [[Ishi Tib]] politician who represented the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]] in the [[Imperial Era|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Concerned only in protecting the galaxy's wealth, Riduli was an advocate and supporter of [[Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart]]'s [[Imperial Defense Recruitment Bill]] in the face of the [[Attack on Kamino|destruction]] of [[Kamino]]'s [[cloning]] facilities.<ref name="The Clone Conspiracy" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Gani Riduli first appeared in the [[The Clone Conspiracy|seventh]]<ref name="The Clone Conspiracy" /> and [[Truth and Consequences|eighth episode]] of the [[The Bad Batch Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'',<ref name="Truth">{{TBB|Truth and Consequences}}</ref> which aired on [[February 8]], [[2024]].<ref name="TBB S2">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-bad-batch-season-2-trailer-key-art|text=Clone Force 99 Is Back in New ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 2 Trailer}}</ref>
